data.long_meaning: The name Andre comes from the Greek word 'andros', meaning man or warrior. It was a common name among ancient Greeks and Romans, and has been used throughout Christian history as well. The name Andre carries the meaning “Man, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Andre usually hope their child will grow to embody man, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אנדרה
in_hebrew.meaning: אדם הגבר חזק ואנדריי איש חזק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אנדרה מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו איש חזק או גבר אמיץ, נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'אנדרוס' שפירושה גבר או איש. השם אנדרה מוזכר בברית החדשה כשליחו של ישוע המשיח, אחיו של פטרוס. לאנדרה מיוחסת חשיבות רבה בקרב הנוצרים כדמות של כוח רוחני ואמונה איתנה.

in_greek.name: Ανδρέας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ανδρέας προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'ανήρ' που σημαίνει άντρας και 'ανδρός' που σημαίνει ισχυρός. Ο Ανδρέας αναφέρεται στα Ευαγγέλια ως ο αδελφός του Πέτρου και ένας από τους πρώτους μαθητές του Ιησού. Το όνομα Ανδρέας συμβολίζει την ανδρεία και την πνευματική δύναμη.

in_latin.name: Andreas
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Andreas derivatur ex voce Graeca 'anēr', quae virum seu masculum significat. In Ecclesia primitiva, Andreas fuit frater Petri et discipulus Iesu Christi. Andreas nomine virtutem et robur spirituale designat.

in_english.name: Andre
in_english.meaning: Strong and manly, courageous and powerful
in_english.long_meaning: The name Andre originates from the Greek 'Andreas', meaning manly or masculine. It is derived from the Greek words 'anēr', meaning man, and 'andros', meaning male. Andre is a significant name in Christian tradition, associated with Saint Andrew, one of Jesus' twelve apostles and the brother of Saint Peter. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and spiritual power. Throughout history, Andre has been a popular name among Christians, reflecting the virtues of manliness and faith.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Andre holds deep spiritual significance for Christians, as it is derived from the Greek word 'andros', meaning man or warrior. historical_references.reference: André the Giant - born André René Roussimoff in 1946, was a French professional wrestler, actor, and bodybuilder. He is considered one of the greatest professional wrestlers of all time and held the World Heavyweight Championship title seven times. André stood at 7 feet 4 inches (2.21 m) tall and weighed over 500 lb (227 kg) during his career.

André the Great - born André de Resau, was a Roman Catholic saint and bishop, venerated as a patron saint of Russia. He was born in the late 11th century and is said to have spent most of his life in Novgorod, Russia, where he was a bishop and a miracle worker. André is known for his role in the Christianization of Russia and his defense against the Swedish invasion in 1143.
